hero.title: Full Stack Developer & Software Engineer

about.title: I work best where architecture, implementation, and quality all matter.
about.description: I work across backend services, frontend development, software architecture, and quality-driven delivery. My projects span full-stack web systems, iOS mobile applications, and machine learning — built with disciplined engineering practices from requirements through deployment.
about.imageCaptionText: Clear technical reasoning, structured implementation, and the discipline to document and validate what gets built.

architectureMindset.title: Architecture mindset
architectureMindset.description: I use structure to reduce complexity, not to decorate the codebase.

executionAcrossLayers.title: Execution across layers
executionAcrossLayers.description: I am comfortable moving from UI implementation to backend logic, validation, and database design.

qualityOrientation.title: Quality orientation
qualityOrientation.description: I work with reviews, standards, and documentation so the project remains maintainable after delivery.

practicalLearning.title: Fast practical learning
practicalLearning.description: I adapt quickly to new stacks — from iOS delivery in SwiftUI to ML classification in Python to full-stack systems in Node.js and React.

timeline.title: How I have taken projects from requirements to delivery.
timeline.description: These are the strongest projects in my portfolio. I use this section to show responsibilities, process, and technical decisions, not just final screens.

altertex.role: Software Architect and Full Stack Developer
altertex.summary: A large-scale enterprise management system executed with CMMI-oriented processes and a delivery model that reflected professional software engineering practices.
altertex.bullet1: Designed the solution using Hexagonal Architecture and Clean Architecture to keep the system modular and maintainable.
altertex.bullet2: Built backend services, data models, and frontend modules for users, roles, categories, quotas, and product flows.
altertex.bullet3: Implemented RBAC permission control, 2FA, input validation, and security-focused API behavior.
altertex.bullet4: Worked with Swagger-documented APIs, formal documentation, structured reviews, and quality checkpoints across the project.
altertex.bullet5: Took an early leadership role to support estimation adjustments and coordination with the external training partner.

wushu.company: Queretaro Wushu Kung Fu Association app
wushu.role: Full Stack Developer for iOS delivery
wushu.summary: A mobile app project covering the full cycle from requirements and architecture to implementation, testing, and TestFlight deployment.
wushu.bullet1: Analyzed functional and non-functional requirements before moving into implementation.
wushu.bullet2: Designed the mobile architecture with MVVM to keep features scalable and responsibilities separated.
wushu.bullet3: Implemented SwiftUI views and app flows with attention to usability and performance.
wushu.bullet4: Validated the product through testing and iterative improvements under a Scrum workflow.
wushu.bullet5: Prepared the application for TestFlight deployment while keeping quality and security in scope.

projects.title: Selected builds and the results they produced.

altertex.title: Altertex enterprise platform
altertex.description: A modular management system built for maintainability, permission control, and secure business workflows.
altertex.result: Delivered modular backend and frontend with RBAC, 2FA, Swagger-documented REST APIs, and formal test coverage across user, product, quota, and category management flows.
altertex.highlight: Keeping RBAC rules, validation logic, and admin workflows consistent across modules without introducing tight coupling.

wushu.title: Wushu iOS application
wushu.description: An iOS app taken from requirements through architecture, interface construction, testing, and TestFlight deployment.
wushu.result: Delivered a SwiftUI MVVM app through the full requirements-to-TestFlight cycle in a 4-month sprint, with structured testing and Scrum-driven iteration.
wushu.highlight: Turning requirements and user flows into a scalable mobile architecture while keeping the app deployment-ready at every sprint.

wc2026.title: World Cup 2026 Match Predictor
wc2026.description: A machine learning model that predicts World Cup 2026 match outcomes using historical match data, team statistics, and tournament context.
wc2026.result: Trained and evaluated ensemble classifiers on historical FIFA match data to forecast tournament match outcomes across the bracket.
wc2026.highlight: Engineering meaningful features from historical football data to produce reliable predictions across diverse team matchups.

defungi.title: DeFungi ML Classifier
defungi.description: A machine learning classifier that identifies and categorizes fungal species from structured biological feature data.
defungi.result: Trained and validated a classification model that accurately identifies fungal species categories from biological feature sets.
defungi.highlight: Selecting and engineering features that distinguish similar fungal species while keeping the model generalizable to unseen data.
